name: Driver Document Expiry Alert Report
query:
SELECT 
d.full_name AS "Driver Name:Data:400",
dda.name1 AS "Document Type:Data:250",
dda.reference_number AS "Reference No:Data:200",
dda.issue_date AS "Issued On:Date:100",
dda.expire_date AS "Expiring On:Date:100" 

FROM `tabTruck Driver` d 
INNER JOIN `tabDocument Attachments` dda ON d.name=dda.parent
WHERE dda.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(),interval dda.send_alert_before day) AND dda.expire_date IS NOT NULL
AND dda.send_alert_before > 0 AND d.status = 'Active' 
ORDER BY dda.expire_date
